papers.title: SPCC: Inferring Spatial Cell-Cell Interaction by Integrating Single-cell and Spatial Transcriptomics.

papers.relevance_cn: 空间组学算法可借鉴于转录组调控与细胞环境分析。

papers.title: Interpretable biophysical neural networks of transcriptional activation domains separate roles of protein abundance and coactivator binding.

papers.relevance_cn: 展示AI结合机制模型解析基因调控，适合生信方法借鉴。

papers.title: Quantum-Enhanced Transfer Learning for IDR Binding Partner Prediction.
papers.journal: IEEE transactions on computational biology and bioinformatics

papers.relevance_cn: 面向蛋白序列与互作预测，体现新型AI/计算框架。

papers.title: Integrative transcriptomic and machine learning approaches reveal candidate genes for silk and venom production in Bibionomorpha (Diptera).

papers.title: Integrative TWAS and multi-omics analyses prioritize HSPE1 as a candidate risk gene for bipolar disorder with immune cell-specific regulatory evidence.
